Info

Defines structural runtime-checkable protocol IScaraCompiler for compiling SCARA DSL scripts directly into binary frame packages and byte streams.

class scaralang.core.service.compiler.icompiler.IScaraCompiler(*args, **kwargs)[source]¶

Bases: Protocol

Structural protocol defining end-to-end SCARA DSL compilation.

It defines:

methods:
compile - Compiles DSL source code into BinaryProgram package.
compile_bytes - Compiles DSL source code directly into wire byte stream.
get_version - Returns compiler version string.
_abc_impl = <_abc._abc_data object>¶
_is_protocol = True¶
_is_runtime_protocol = True¶
compile(*, source: str) → BinaryProgram[source]¶

Compiles DSL source code into a binary program package.

Parameters:

source – Raw .scara script text.

Returns:

BinaryProgram package containing packed binary frames.

compile_bytes(*, source: str) → bytes[source]¶

Compiles DSL source code directly into a binary wire byte stream.

Parameters:

source – Raw .scara script text.

Returns:

Raw byte stream suitable for UART transmission.

get_version() → str[source]¶

Returns the compiler version string representation.

Returns:

Version string representation.
